flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed then Find a stock or scarcity message on the first product (for example "Only 3 left" or "12 in stock") and store its exact text as stock_1.
Get the product name from the first product title and save as {{product_name}}.
Reload the page and store {{product_name}}'s stock message as stock_2.
Reload once more and store it as stock_3.
Do not add anything to the cart.
If there is no stock message, @v16:"store \"none\" for all three".
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.

analyze: {{product_name}}'s stock message is stored as {{stock_2}}.

summary:
The first product visibly showed “12 in stock,” but the agent recorded that no stock message existed. It therefore followed the wrong path and did not reliably save the required values or perform the two requested reload checks.
Update the agent to read the first product card before deciding the fallback path. It should save product_name as “AirWave Pro Earbuds” and stock_1, stock_2, and stock_3 as the exact visible text “12 in stock,” reloading between each later capture.
one_liner: The run failed because the agent said there was no stock message even though the first product showed one, then did not complete the required captures and reloads before the browser closed.
